lines.text: Amos says woe to those at ease in Zion, and sends them to Calneh, Hamath and Gath.
They lie on ivory beds, dine on lambs and calves, and drink wine by the bowlful.
They will go into exile as the first of the captives, and their feasting will end.
If twenty men are left in one house they will die, and the great house will be smashed.
They boast of taking Karnaim by their own strength, so the LORD will raise up a king against Israel.
